family.description: YacG inhibits all the catalytic activities of DNA gyrase by preventing its interaction with DNA. It acts by binding directly to the C-terminal domain of GyrB, which probably disrupts DNA binding by the gyrase [[cite:PUB00060604]]. YacG has been shown to bind zinc and contains the structural motifs typical of zinc-binding proteins [[cite:PUB00022116]]. The conserved four cysteine motif in this protein (-C-X(2)-C-X(15)-C-X(3)-C-) is not found in other zinc-binding proteins with known structures.
family.name: DNA gyrase inhibitor YacG
